BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

2. When learning Building Construction Project Phase 11, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Construction Project Phase 11.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Remove all guards

4. When learning Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Building Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Drawing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Drawing.

5. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.

6. When learning Introduction to Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Drawing.

7. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

8. When learning Waste Water Disposal, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Waste Water Disposal.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Waste Water Disposal.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Waste Water Disposal.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Waste Water Disposal.

9. When learning Floor Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Floor Finishes.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Floor Finishes.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Floor Finishes.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Floor Finishes.

10. When learning Ceilings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ceilings.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ceilings.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ceilings.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Ceilings.

11. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

12. When learning Wall Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Wall Finishes.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wall Finishes.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wall Finishes.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wall Finishes.

13. When learning Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.

14. When learning Building Material Schedules, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Material Schedules.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Material Schedules.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Material Schedules.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Building Material Schedules.

15. When learning Pre-cast Concrete Products, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-cast Concrete Products.

16. When learning Fixings and Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fixings and Fittings.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fixings and Fittings.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Fixings and Fittings.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Ceilings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Fixings and Fittings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Pre-cast Concrete Products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Building Material Schedules and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Waste Water Disposal and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Maintenance of Plumbing Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
